notebooks.title: 一阶方程与输入
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', nonnegative=True)
s = sp.symbols('s', real=True)

cells.code:
T = 20 + 60*sp.exp(-t/2)
z = sp.exp(-t) + sp.integrate(2*sp.exp(-(t-s)), (s,0,t))
print('冷却解/初值/方程余量:', T, T.subs(t,0), sp.simplify(sp.diff(T,t)+(T-20)/2))
print('第2分钟:', sp.N(T.subs(t,2),12))
print('常输入解/初值/ln2时:', sp.simplify(z), z.subs(t,0), sp.simplify(z.subs(t,sp.log(2))))
print('常输入方程余量:', sp.simplify(sp.diff(z,t)+z-2))

notebooks.title: 高阶方程与矩阵级数
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
A = sp.Matrix([[0,1],[-1,0]])
R = (A*t).exp()
N = sp.Matrix([[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[0,0,0]])
EN = sp.eye(3)+t*N+t*t*N*N/2
print('振动A平方:', A*A)
print('振动矩阵指数:', R)
print('pi/2时位置与速度:', sp.simplify(R.subs(t,sp.pi/2)*sp.Matrix([1,0])))
print('幂零N立方:', N**3)
print('幂零指数/第2时刻:', EN, EN.subs(t,2))
print('指数核验:', sp.simplify((N*t).exp()-EN))

notebooks.title: 对角化与指数乘法边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', real=True)

cells.code:
B = sp.Matrix([[-1,1],[0,-2]])
P = sp.Matrix([[1,-1],[0,1]])
L = sp.diag(-1,-2)
EB = sp.simplify(P*(L*t).exp()*P.inv())
U = sp.Matrix([[0,1],[0,0]])
V = sp.Matrix([[0,0],[1,0]])
print('对角化余量:', B-P*L*P.inv())
print('指数:', EB)
print('ln2时矩阵/解:', sp.simplify(EB.subs(t,sp.log(2))), sp.simplify(EB.subs(t,sp.log(2))*sp.Matrix([0,1])))
print('零矩阵指数/逐元素指数:', sp.zeros(2).exp(), sp.zeros(2).applyfunc(sp.exp))
print('非交换PQ-QP:', U*V-V*U)
print('指数相乘:', U.exp()*V.exp())
print('和的指数:', (U+V).exp())

notebooks.title: 串联水箱与重根
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', nonnegative=True)
a,b = sp.symbols('a b', positive=True)

cells.code:
A = sp.Matrix([[-1,0],[1,-1]])
E = (A*t).exp()
x = E*sp.Matrix([1,0])
other = b*(sp.exp(-a*t)-sp.exp(-b*t))/(b-a)
print('特征值/特征向量:', A.eigenvects())
print('矩阵指数/轨迹:', E, x)
K = A + sp.eye(2)
print('K平方/指数初值/矩阵方程余量:', K*K, E.subs(t,0), sp.simplify(E.diff(t)-A*E))
print('初值/方程余量:', x.subs(t,0), sp.simplify(x.diff(t)-A*x))
for q in [1,2,8]:
    print('时刻/浓度/变化率:', q, x.subs(t,q).evalf(12), (A*x).subs(t,q).evalf(12))
print('第二箱导数/极限:', sp.diff(x[1],t), sp.limit(x[1],t,sp.oo))
print('速率趋同:', sp.simplify(sp.limit(other,b,a)))
print('不同速率方程余量/初值:', sp.simplify(sp.diff(other,t)-b*(sp.exp(-a*t)-other)), sp.simplify(other.subs(t,0)))
print('a1b2第1分钟:', sp.N(other.subs({a:1,b:2,t:1}),12))

notebooks.title: 持续输入与奇异矩阵
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', nonnegative=True)
s = sp.symbols('s', real=True)

cells.code:
A = sp.Matrix([[-1,0],[1,-1]])
f = sp.Matrix([1,0])
y = sp.simplify(sp.integrate((A*(t-s)).exp()*f,(s,0,t)))
print('输入积分解:', y)
print('初值/方程余量:', y.subs(t,0), sp.simplify(y.diff(t)-A*y-f))
print('ln2时精确/近似:', sp.simplify(y.subs(t,sp.log(2))), y.subs(t,sp.log(2)).evalf(12))
Z = sp.zeros(2)
z = sp.integrate((Z*(t-s)).exp()*sp.Matrix([1,2]),(s,0,t))
print('A零时积分:', z, '第2时刻:', z.subs(t,2))

notebooks.title: 唯一性与有限时间边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', nonnegative=True)
x = sp.symbols('x', real=True)

cells.code:
zero = sp.Integer(0)
branch = t*t/4
blow = 1/(1-t)
print('两条分支初值:', zero, branch.subs(t,0))
print('非零分支方程余量:', sp.simplify(sp.diff(branch,t)-sp.sqrt(sp.Abs(branch))))
print('第1时刻两分支:', zero, branch.subs(t,1))
print('sqrt变化率比值:', sp.limit(sp.sqrt(x)/x,x,0,dir='+'))
print('发散例初值/余量/左极限:', blow.subs(t,0), sp.simplify(sp.diff(blow,t)-blow**2), sp.limit(blow,t,1,dir='-'))

notebooks.title: 六题答案复算
notebooks.setupCode:
import sympy as sp
t = sp.symbols('t', nonnegative=True)

cells.code:
print('题1解/第2分钟/初始斜率:',20+60*sp.exp(-t/2),sp.N(20+60/sp.E,12),-30)
R = sp.Matrix([[sp.cos(t),sp.sin(t)],[-sp.sin(t),sp.cos(t)]])
print('题2:', R.subs(t,sp.pi/2)*sp.Matrix([1,0]))
N = sp.Matrix([[0,1,0],[0,0,1],[0,0,0]])
E2 = (2*N).exp()
print('题3指数/解:',E2,E2*sp.Matrix([0,0,1]))
B = sp.Matrix([[-1,1],[0,-2]])
EB = sp.simplify((B*sp.log(2)).exp())
print('题4指数/解:',EB,EB*sp.Matrix([0,1]))
wash = sp.Matrix([sp.exp(-2),2*sp.exp(-2)])
feed = sp.Matrix([sp.Rational(1,2),(1-sp.log(2))/2])
print('题5冲洗/持续输入:',wash.evalf(12),feed,feed.evalf(12))
print('题6两分支第1时刻:',0,sp.Rational(1,4))
branch = t*t/4
print('题6分支方程余量:',sp.simplify(sp.diff(branch,t)-sp.sqrt(branch)))
print('题6发散左极限:',sp.limit(1/(1-t),t,1,dir='-'))
